'''T6-D4''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. After the [[Conquest of Makeb]], it was sent to [[Keylander Station]] as a courier by [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] to help him enlist the services of the Republic strike force regarding the mysteries surrounding the survival of the planet, [[Makeb]].<ref name="TOR" />
